subject: SSO/SCIM audit: entitlement snapshot & ingress justification
messages:
From: Kerry Mills <kerry.mills@innovahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: audit-ops@innovahealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Entitlement snapshot + ingress justification for SIG follow-up

Hi Jonas / Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. The SIG review team has asked for two short deliverables to close out control SC-1.3: an "entitlement snapshot" covering active accounts and role assignments for the 30-day window ending 2027-07-01, and an "ingress justification" memo describing how identities are granted access (SSO, SCIM, provisioning owners). They also asked for a short sample of SAML assertion logs for a handful of admin-privileged flows.

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can provide the snapshot as a CSV (SCIM delta preferred) with role columns and owner IDs
- A one-page ingress justification (PDF) we can include in the SIG evidence bundle
- A delivery mechanism (SFTP, Drive link, or HubSpot attachment) and an estimated ETA (we're on a 10-business-day window)

If any of the artifacts contain PII, we can accept hashed identifiers. We mainly need the mapping from account -> role -> owner, and the change type (create/update/delete).

Thanks,
Kerry
Kerry Mills
Senior IT Audit Manager | InnovaHealth
[kerry.mills@innovahealth.com]

[attachment: initial_control_questions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kerry Mills <kerry.mills@innovahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement snapshot + ingress justification for SIG follow-up

Kerry — thanks, we can handle this. High-level plan:

1) Entitlement snapshot (SCIM delta CSV)
   - We'll generate scim_delta_20270701-0729.csv with columns: user_id (hashed), username (masked), role, role_scope, owner_id (hashed), change_type, timestamp.
2) SAML assertion samples
   - We'll include a small set (10) of admin-role assertion excerpts — saml_assertion_samples.txt (assertion IDs hashed, timestamps preserved).
3) Ingress justification memo
   - One-page PDF that covers SSO onboarding flow, SCIM provisioning triggers, and owner approval gates.

Delivery: we prefer a secure Drive link with restricted view + downloader audit enabled. If you require SFTP, we can push to your endpoint. ETA: preliminary artifacts by 2027-07-29 EOD, final redacted set within 3 business days after your review.

A couple quick clarifying questions for the audit team:
- Do you need separations between human vs service accounts in the snapshot, or can we mark service accounts with a tag (svc_)?
- For owner identifiers, is hashed email + owner role sufficient, or do you need a named contact?

Looping in Rishi and Laura for technical and delivery notes.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
[attachment: acceptance_note.txt (txt)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kerry Mills <kerry.mills@innovahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement snapshot + ingress justification for SIG follow-up

Kerry — technical notes on the SCIM delta:
- The system will produce a delta export for the window 2027-06-01 -> 2027-07-01. The CSV will include an action column (ADD/UPDATE/REMOVE) and a role_source column (SSO-provisioned/scim-sync/manual).
- Service accounts will be tagged with prefix svc_ in the username column; we will include a separate boolean column is_service_account.
- SAML assertion samples: we will redact IPs and session tokens but preserve assertion timestamps, NameID (hashed) and role claim values.

Privacy: PII will be hashed using SHA256 with a rolling salt. We will provide a short README describing the hashing approach.

Delivery mechanics: we can stage the artifacts to a Drive folder and share a link. For automated ingestion, we can also upload to your SFTP — let us know host/path and we will schedule a secure transfer.

Action items:
- Kerry: confirm delivery preference (Drive vs SFTP) and whether the audit team needs named owner contact or hashed owner_id only.
- Laura / Priyom: target 2027-07-29 EOD for first upload.

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kerry Mills <kerry.mills@innovahealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement snapshot + ingress justification for SIG follow-up

Kerry — quick delivery note and sample filenames attached. We staged the artifacts to a restricted Drive folder and added an ACL for audit-ops@innovahealth.com. Link in HubSpot record below.

Files included in the upload:
- scim_delta_20270701-0729.csv (SCIM delta, hashed IDs)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (10 assertion excerpts, IPs redacted)
- ingress_owner_roster_20270729.xlsx (owner mapping; owner email hashed; owner_role column included)
- ingress_justification_20270729.pdf (one-page ingress justification)
- hashing_readme.txt (hashing algorithm and salt handling notes)

HubSpot/Drive links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Innova-SOC2-SSO (shared with audit-ops@innovahealth.com) | HubSpot: HS-12345

Notes:
- We flagged service accounts with is_service_account=TRUE.
- If you need named owner contacts for callbacks, we can provide a redacted mapping under a separate LOA.
- Let us know if you want the raw SCIM payloads (JSON) in addition to the CSV; we can provide those but will need additional redaction work.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
